concepts.gloss_en: The illuminating word/speech — speech that shines/illuminates, merited through guarding God's honor and humility (Torah 11)

reason_for_human: All seven occurrences are in Torah 11 and refer to the same idea: illuminating speech merited through guarding God's honor. The singular דבור המאיר and plural דבורים המאירים (and the equivalent phrasings לדבור שיאיר לו / לדבר דבורים המאירים) are just number/inflection of one word and one concept, not homographs. Standard singular↔plural variation = same concept.
